author: UpwindMDR
text: Google fixes 9 Chrome vulnerabilities including in-the-wild zero-day CVE-2026-125350 (UAF in the XML component), actively exploited to bypass restrictions.

author: cyb3rxpl0it
text: Google patched actively exploited Chrome zero-day CVE-2026-125350, a high-severity use-after-free in the XML component, reported Nov 6. 8th exploited Chrome zero-day of 2026. Update to 157.0.8103.50/.51.

author: opsek_io
text: Chrome 157 security update: 9 vulnerabilities fixed. CVE-2026-125350 XML use-after-free (exploited in the wild); CVE-2026-125344 V8 type confusion; CVE-2026-125348 GPU out-of-bounds write.

author: BytesNora
text: CVE-2026-116779 in FreeSWITCH is a critical RCE (CVSS 9.8) that's actively exploited, despite a low EPSS (1%).

author: ICHI_Global
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-116779 SignalWire FreeSwitch <1.11.3 code injection, CVSS 9.8, CISA KEV actively exploited. Unauthenticated code injection via ESL socket. Patch: 1.11.3+.

author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical WP Duplicate unauth arbitrary file upload to RCE (CVE-2026-123751): plugin <= 1.1.11 lets unauthenticated attackers write arbitrary files such as PHP webshells.

author: CveTodo
text: A critical unauthenticated RCE vulnerability in the WP Duplicate WordPress plugin is being actively exploited in the wild.

author: 2Workly
text: Plex2Shell (CVE-2026-96652 chain) is actively exploited against QNAP NAS Plex instances for unauthenticated RCE. Patch to 1.43.3+.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-102895 CRITICAL, actively exploited per CISA KEV: GPUStack (AI GPU cluster manager). CVSS 9.8.

author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-119977 WordPress Core TOCTOU race condition during full core upgrades: unauthenticated RCE via predictable staging paths in wp-content/upgrade. Actively exploited; CISA KEV Nov 3. Affects 4.7 through 7.1.3; fixed in 7.1.4.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-123218: IBM Aspera Faspex authorization bypass actively exploited; CISA added to KEV on November 9, 2026.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CISA KEV (Nov 9, 2026): four actively exploited CVEs added, including GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, IBM Aspera Faspex.

author: vulnpocalypse
text: A jailbroken AI agent attacked a European telecom and 13 hosted organizations for two weeks; patch Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 now.

author: DuckButTurttle
text: Operation Snowball: an AI-agent intrusion into a European telecom exploited Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320. Researchers say it reached a hospital records system on default credentials (unverified).

author: undercode_news
text: Hackers build self-sustaining AI agent to steal API keys, exploit academic systems and commit student data fraud.

author: threatroundup
text: Ivanti VPN zero-day operator's next proxy found serving an open directory: exploit framework, 168 run logs and a Russian AI-agent memo naming every server swap.

author: infrastack_ai
text: Unpatched flaws in xAI's Grok Bot agent sandbox let one prompt-injected command take root, Profero found; saved logins, cookies or API keys could be exposed.

author: theagenticdaily
text: A single crafted link could trick Atlassian's Rovo AI agent into leaking private Confluence, Jira, and SharePoint data via prompt injection seeded in a URL parameter (DEF CON research; bug bounty paid).

author: mergenewsapp
text: Docker Sandboxes flaw (CVE-2026-77179) on macOS affects AI agent sandboxing; update to v0.42.0+.

author: abhiunix
text: Fable 5.2 system card prompt injection result: when the cyber classifier fires, requests are answered by a fallback model; in Gray Swan's adaptive coding eval about 90% of those were compromised.

author: saltrocklabs
text: WorkOS write-up: an AI agent found exposed API endpoints, logged in with a dev credential left in prod, and pulled records with no rate limit.

author: DataconomyMedia
text: Apiiro found 2,539 exposed credentials in 1,994 public GitHub repositories linked to a Claude Code flaw (settings.local.json saving approved commands). Teams are urged to rotate keys.

author: UrekaDev
text: Apiiro: 1,122 Claude Code settings files held real creds (379 DB passwords, 23 AWS keys). Rotate keys, add .claude/settings.local.json to .gitignore.

author: AIBandwagon
text: Fireworks AI told customers an intruder got in on Oct 24 through a cloud provider and reached billing data, plus secrets, datasets and partial model weights for some accounts. Bloomberg says it's their second breach in weeks. Rotate keys.

author: amitpgupta
text: Fireworks AI detailed update on October security incident: Oct 23 a third-party cloud provider hosting its development machines was breached; Oct 24 attackers got in.

author: _pksharma
text: Fireworks AI bulletin before/after: Oct 9 said env vars incl. API keys and tokens exposed; Nov 9 update adds account info, billing, datasets and partial model weights.

author: StanleyCui
text: Inference providers are attack surface: Fireworks and NEAR AI both disclosed incidents this week, one via a cloud vendor, one via an SGLang RCE. Rotate keys and scope creds.

author: ZeroDayFacts
text: Qubole AWS integration abused in multi-customer cloud breach: Wiz found attackers exploiting trusted AWS cross-account access to steal credentials and customer data.

author: cytexsmb
text: Qubole supply-chain attack: between Oct 14 and 26, an attacker used IAM credentials from idle customer integrations with still-active AWS access.

author: SlowMist_Team
text: Supply chain attack compromised Ethersphere's npm package @ethersphere/bee-js@13.3.0 and Swarm Desktop v0.56.2 via compromised GitHub accounts and legitimate release pipelines.

author: edanielfagundes
text: bee-js 13.3.0 shipped via stolen CI creds: postinstall stealer and backdoor on Linux, macOS and Windows, with valid npm provenance. Pin 13.2.0.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: Supply chain attack on Ethersphere's Swarm tooling delivered wallet-stealing malware and backdoors via the project's own CI pipeline, using stolen credentials to publish signed, notarized releases.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: GhostAction returns: hijacked GitHub maintainer accounts push fake 'security audit' GitHub Actions workflows that steal cloud, AI and package-publishing secrets (Socket).

author: cubillas888
text: Ruby gem strutil-core 1.0.1 supply chain attack poisons AI tool configs; revoking the stolen GitHub token first can wipe your home folder (Socket).

author: eastsidemccarty
text: Coordinated Rust dependency confusion supply chain attack targeting Zcash, Zcash Foundation, Vizor, Cosmos and Keplr wallet projects.

author: ESultanik
text: Attempted supply chain attack on Graphtage: a trusted external contributor's GitHub account was presumably compromised after submitting a PR.
